{{Quote|Stop them&hellip; Stop Isen&hellip; for good of all&hellip;!|The last words of Pobos|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
'''Pobos''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who worked as an informant for [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]]<ref name="Legacy 49" /> in [[138 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> After [[Cade Skywalker]] accepted a job from Vedo to kill [[One Sith|Sith]] scientist [[Vul Isen]], whom he was already hunting, Vedo sent Pobos to meet Skywalker on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to disclose Isen's precise whereabouts. However, Pobos was followed to the rendezvous point by [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]], who shot the Bothan before Skywalker and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wolf Sazen]] could finish them off. While [[Death/Legends|dying]], Pobos provided Skywalker with Isen's location and a warning that the scientist had sent [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] after [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], who was taking refuge on the planet. Pobos' last words implored Skywalker to stop Isen and the assassins.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pobos appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 49|forty-ninth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], pencilled by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="Legacy 49" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[June 30]], [[2010]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/17-107/Star-Wars-Legacy-49---Extremes-Part-2|text=Star Wars: Legacy #49 - Extremes (Part 2)}}</ref>
